The agent-browser CLI reported '--profile ignored: daemon already running'.  The browser-level isolation came from the Chrome instance itself: its own DevTools port, its own profile directory under target/forms-capture/, its own headless window.

The form block fields (form_id, clear_on_submit, border, enter_to_submit) are not part of the base decoder's summary; they are read from the same raw bytes with the same official protobuf definitions and written beside the frame as form_blocks.
